title: Bookshelf Brotherhood
content: Stefan KopinskihasColor and LightandImaginative Realismon his bookshelf.Stefanis a freelance illustrator for the games industry who visualizes "weird and wonderful ideas" for Sega, Capcom, Forge World, Mantic, and THQ.
